GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Performance Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J and navigate to the performance tab. In firefox, be sure to use CTRL + SHIFT + I

At first glance, it looks like something went wrong with the screen. That's not what happened here. The whole graph is the runtime for DOM.html page. In Main, a timeline of function calls is shown. Each top-level box is a function. Each box beneath it is smaller, as a result of a nested function call.

The summary graph's range details are dynamically updated when the graph timeline changes.
